Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L06_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.PRES.01

Digital presentation item 1: Which choice best supports coherent ideas in a speech presentation?

answer.text: A. Put the full speech paragraph on every slide

feedback.text: This choice does not fit the audience or purpose clearly enough. Check how word meaning or digital structure affects the listener.

answer.text: B. Use random images that do not support the point

feedback.text: This choice may sound related, but it does not fully support clear speech communication for the audience.

answer.text: C. Create slides with one clear focus connected to the central idea

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports clear, audience-aware communication through precise word meaning or coherent digital presentation design.

answer.text: D. Add decoration that distracts from the message

feedback.text: This choice weakens the presentation because it ignores how the audience understands the message.
